description: Backward-facing step steady base flow at Re=500 via DNS settle and Newton-GMRES (two phases in run.local.slurm). Regression values of this repository, reproduced on Jean Zay (ifort, 8 ranks) and in the June run.

produced.nekstab_mode: 2.0 (Newton-GMRES fixed point), seeded by a DNS

newton_final_residual.note: Final Newton residual (column 7) must not exceed the Newton tolerance (column 8).

newton_iterations.note: Convergence takes 4 iterations from the DNS-settled seed.
